def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        guests = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        room_id, room_code, snap = self._tcb_setup_room(guests)
        host = self._ui_bootstrap(snap)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=20)
        self.assertFalse(
            host.is_start_enabled(),
            "2 人时开始互动应不可用",
        )

        add = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add > 0:
            self._unwrap_cloud(
                self.cloud.seed_players(
                    MysteryReasonPage.game_key,
                    room_id=room_id,
                    count=add,
                )
            )
            snap = self._unwrap_cloud(
                self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
            )
            host.apply_room_snapshot(snap)
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=20)
        self.assertTrue(
            host.is_start_enabled(),
            "3 人时开始互动应可用",
        )

        started = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.start_game(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        )
        self.assertFalse(started.get("errMsg"), str(started.get("errMsg")))
        snap = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        )
        host.apply_room_snapshot(snap)
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()
